annotations.detail: Ledger only ever computes 'in-code' (41 rows) or 'doc-only' (13 rows) - no 'designed', 'code+needs-test-or-review', 'code+tests-present (unrun)', or 'verified' rows exist. Consistent with raw data: every manifest entry has refs.tests=[] and refs.review=[] (no cargo: entries, so the cargo: ambiguity never arises), and of the docs referenced in refs.docs only docs/features/FEAT-G-DAMAGE.md has YAML frontmatter with a status field at all (status: draft) - every other FEAT-G-*.md has no frontmatter block, so 'designed' (refs.code empty + docs ref with status accepted/stable) is unreachable given the current source docs. Re-derived by hand for all 8 sampled rows; all matched the ledger's computed value.
